derivation.algorithm: deriveSeedHex SHA-256 UTF-8 parts joined by one NUL byte
derivation.rule: Base parts are root, LV01, stage, v1, slot kind, four-digit index, purpose. Partition, receiver role, case and branch append explicit parts. Every materialized seed must be unique across LV01 and existing registrations.
derivation.sharedPairing: Scenario/case identities and receiver action draws omit branch; independent intervention shuffles append branch. Learner initialization occurs once per dyad.
prohibited: reuse of development, qualification, pilot, confirmatory or replication identities

qualification.purpose: selected topology, detector, fault, lifecycle and resource qualification

pilot.outcomeUse: dispersion, validity and measured resource input only

confirmatory.selection: smallest candidate whose six-component union-bound lower power is at least 0.90 and whose complete allocation fits
confirmatory.replacement: ordered reserves replace validity failures only

replication.rule: fresh stage identities use the same selected N and ordered reserve rule as confirmatory; no outcome-based retuning

power.monteCarloLowerBound: if k=0 then 0 else qbeta(0.05/36, k, 30000-k+1)
power.familyLowerBound: max(0, 1 - sum over six components of (1 - component lower bound))
power.reserveInvalidity: one-sided 95% Wilson upper invalid-run probability; choose smallest R with P[Binomial(N+R,pUpper)<=R] >= 0.95

resources.measurement: Reconcile historical charges first. Record every service CPU, conservative peak memory, raw/exported bytes, verification, analysis, teardown and failures.
resources.calibration: After five complete full-workload development dyads, reserve two times the largest complete per-slot CPU/storage/wall cost and 1.5 times the conservative peak-memory bound.
resources.designLock: Reserve 2*(N+R) complete slots for confirmatory plus replication, full analysis/reproduction, benchmark and temporary packaging. Missing measurement blocks admission.
prohibited: treating historical remaining balances as current capacity
reducing N or reserves after pilot

claimBoundary: This policy does not allocate a stage, select N, authorize execution or create a finding.
